name: Zerek, Master Cloner
guide_text: Use this hero power like reno and use it on the first value generator you see, such as [[Bigwig Bandit||122179]]. A lot of times that comes from pressing your dark gift on turn 4 or 6.
buddy_guide_text: If you haven't used hero power, use your first buddy on a directional tavern 4 or 5 in the shop, buy it, and hero power it to make it golden. Use your second set of buddies to make another core card golden if you roll into it.
